name: agent-watch
description: A themeable Windows home for your local coding agents.
author: William Pyle

scripts.test:desktop: node scripts/desktop-smoke.mjs && node scripts/world-smoke.mjs && node scripts/smurfs-smoke.mjs && node scripts/borg-smoke.mjs
scripts.build: npm run themes:check && electron-builder --win nsis --x64 --publish never

releaseInfo.releaseNotes:
A clearer viewer with fullscreen controls.

- Normal viewing uses continuous floor surfaces without the placement grid or repeated tile-edge lattice.
- Edit world retains tile boundaries and the placement grid, with a checkbox to hide the overlay when desired.
- Click Fullscreen or press F11 to expand the world to the display. Esc, F11 or Exit fullscreen returns to the window.
- Pan, zoom and world editing remain available in fullscreen. Window bounds, previous section and unsaved drafts are retained on exit.
- All five theme previews and the workspace guide, release details and screenshots are updated. Original artwork and saved layouts are preserved.

Validation: 42 unit tests; desktop and packaged checks for native fullscreen, keyboard/button exits, restored window bounds, preserved drafts, viewer/editor floor pixels, water/smoke and Borg lighting.

Download Agent-Watch-Setup-0.4.1-x64.exe below. Builds remain unsigned.
